profile.headline: Software engineer with 14 years in the industry, the last 6 focused on distributed cloud systems at Microsoft. Technical lead on Intune’s Mobile Application Management service
profile.summary:
Senior software engineer with 10+ years of experience in the industry around Microsoft Azure / net technologies. 
Develop apis from endpoint to storage for various industries from criminal records to windows device management.

positions.title: Team Leader R&D
positions.description:
- Development of new features for PSIMS software (Physical Security Information Management System)
- Lead a team of 4 developpers in charge of new feature's set production. (full stack : Ui/BackEnd)
- Use of Scrum/Kanban methodology to ensure production lifecycle
- Interns management

Technologies used:.
-NET C# /F#
-WPF XAML (UI and backend)
-Akka .net (actor and message passing pattern)

positions.title: .Net Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Development of features on a media planning software to manage advertisments broadcast room for TV/Radio
-Analysis of customer needs
-Creation of a new data system and creation of a migration tool based on an ORM (Nhibernate)
-Study and development of plug-ins for a webserver using REST MEF (Microsoft Extensible Framework)

-Study And development of a software for television advertising planning and web

Technologies used: .NET 4.5 platform (WPF)
- Interfaces (XAML)
- Data Access (Nhibernate)

positions.title: .Net/ Multiplatform software Engineer
positions.description: .NET/WPF developer on marine navigation software, best known for bringing the product to iPad using Xamarin — an early move into mobile for the company, translating an established desktop navigation experience to a touch-based platform. Also worked on the embedded-systems side, developing features and resolving critical UI issues for the onboard navigation hardware used by sailors at sea.

positions.title: End studies internship : .Net developper intern
positions.description:
Study and improvement of WF workflow hosted in a SharePoint environment

projects.title: Project "Terre Catalane pour tous"
projects.description:
End studies project 3 month

Management of 4 students to drive them in a development of interactive wpf applications for tourists.
Applications were installed on famous touristic places in south east of France. They provide a rich user experience to complete the information about the site which are visited.
